# Devank Nassa

> Product engineer in Delhi, India. Frontend developer for four years; since the start of 2026, building whole products on my own. Looking for product engineering work, remote or hybrid from Delhi.

Contact: devanknassa@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/DevankNassa
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/devank-nassa

Skills shown in the projects below: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Flutter (iOS), Python, FastAPI, SQLite, Node.js, Fastify, Prisma, Redis, BullMQ, Go, d3, Remotion. I build with AI coding tools, including Claude Code; the commit history shows where.

## Projects

- [Instant Playlist](https://www.devank.dev/instant-playlist/): iPhone music player for songs you already own. Tag songs, then set Only / Any / No faders to build a playlist; tags are saved in each song file. Flutter. Submitted to the App Store, October 2026. Code: https://github.com/DevankNassa/music_player
- [Kosh](https://github.com/DevankNassa/kosh): portfolio review tool for an independent mutual fund distributor. Client holdings, effect of market moves and news, tax effect of a change before it's made. Imports CAS statements, stores daily AMFI and NSE prices. FastAPI, SQLite, React. Showcase MVP, not in production.
- [The Barely Passing Manual](https://www.devank.dev/chemistry-game/): daily Wordle-style puzzle built on the CBSE Class 12 chemistry practical. React, TypeScript, Vite. Playable prototype. Code: https://github.com/DevankNassa/salt-analysis
- [The Lottery](https://www.devank.dev/lottery/): eight machines that show real odds (loot boxes, slots, Powerball, booster packs, CPU binning, a job hunt). Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, d3 for the globe.
- [mf-backend](https://github.com/DevankNassa/mf-backend): mutual fund NAV backend with a queued-job worker. Node.js, Fastify, Prisma, Redis, BullMQ.
- [ChirpyGo](https://github.com/DevankNassa/ChirpyGo): Go server, boot.dev course project.
- Volunteer: websites and Meta ad account setup for friends and family (no public link).
